_comment: Hand-maintained inputs of scripts/characterization_report.py. Verdicts are NOT here: they come from the 'Current reading' digest of spec/gap-to-submission.md. Evidence entries name an experiment (resolved to its live, non-superseded records) or one record_id (which must be live). Every number below is copied from the cited record's Claim.

1.target: UART, SPI modes 0-3, I2C Standard+Fast as firmware
1.measured: Firmware passes the independent reference models at RTL and gate level; constrained-random suite passes (UART RX included)
1.conditions: RTL / zero-delay gate level, 50 MHz clock

3.measured: Formal property proved within the harness model, single engine; serial-load shift-in not modelled

4.measured: Closes at 20 ns on 3 of the 6 declared corners on BOTH flows post-route: LibreLane and klt (def mode over the flow-of-record routed DEF + its own extracted SPEF, propagated clock, complete SDC-derived constraints); the klt pre-CTS hold failure is superseded history; see the Fmax table and the klt paragraph

5.measured: Top instantiates the full pin budget; runtime uio direction rests on Proposed DR 0012

6.target: 256x16 program memory, serial or boot-ROM load
6.measured: Load, CRC integrity and boot paths pass on the SRAM-macro-backed memory; no silicon clock demonstrated

7.measured: See the area table: macro-backed design is 58.55 % of the 2x2 core on LibreLane; the klt P&R leg now measures die 161,592 um^2 (8.96 tiles, 2.24x the 2x2 budget) at 41.83 % placed utilization; budget row stays unmet per the tracker (DR 0005 unratified)

8.measured: SDF-annotated post-route regression passes at 3 corners; SRAM timing zero-delay and some gate-level images stale

9.measured: Licence set, template wired, gds workflow jobs green on the harness stub; final-design sign-off run still to come

10.measured: Cycles only, no baud measured; TX at 434 cycles/bit measured in cycles (0.000 % frame drift, firmware-uart-rx record)

11.measured: All four modes at the f_clk/4 ceiling as a cycle ratio; pad edge rates uncharacterized

12.target: I2C Standard and Fast-mode minimum timings
12.measured: Minimums met in cycles on a logical pad model; stale gate-level/SDF records for the Fast-mode images
12.conditions: RTL, cycle counts, zero-delay pad model

13.target: A protocol outside rows 1-2 as firmware
13.measured: WS2812 and PS/2 pass their models at RTL and gate level; row not ratified

14.measured: (a), (b), reselect pass zero-delay; release-offset sweep passes under SDF at 3 corners; pads not covered; row not ratified

klt_timing.status: post-route result (def mode: the flow-of-record routed DEF, the run's own extracted nominal SPEF, a propagated clock, and the run's own final-SDC boundary constraints with constraint_completeness complete) produced by klt 0.9.2 (git commit 046ba74652fc, recorded in each corner response) over IHP-Open-PDK commit f7bca32694fe3d58be0cc7d9df4b9f5db7161a14, on gds run 44797672107 at a9c989e05: setup AND hold close at 20 ns at the 3 macro-characterized corners -- setup WNS +6.52121 / +10.76340 / +11.10590 ns, hold WNS +0.60123 / +0.28700 / +0.10292 ns (slow / typ / fast), 0 setup and 0 hold violating endpoints at each, implied fmax 74.2 / 108.3 / 112.4 MHz. Residual offset vs the same run's LibreLane stapostpnr on identical geometry (+0.0322..+0.7365 ns setup, +0.0199..+0.0410 ns hold, klt the more optimistic) is the SDC's set_timing_derate/set_clock_transition, which the klt sta request schema cannot express (2AMLogic/klayout-tools#7025, closed as a duplicate of the open #7014/#7015). Supersedes the netlist-estimate record whose pre-CTS hold failed at all 3 corners (worst -0.2266 ns; no placement, CTS or hold repair)

area.item: Placed cells + SRAM macro, share of 2x2 core
Top-level synthesized cell area (2,526 instances, sequential 12,933.0432 um^2)

area.value: die 161,592 um^2 / core 156,242 um^2 at 41.83 % placed utilization (40 % requested) = 8.96 tiles = 2.24x the 2x2 budget; program memory alone: die 84,204.4 um^2 at 40.68 % (klt 0.9.2, IHP-Open-PDK f7bca326, SRAM macro fixed at (7,7) R0, stage place, no PDN)

power.reason: On the routed DEF with SPEF-annotated parasitics, `klt sta` estimates 2.4618 mW at slow, 3.1065 mW at typical and 3.9263 mW at fast. The estimates use engine-default switching activity. There is no workload activity trace, measured dynamic power or committed LibreLane power report for these corners. The target specification defines no power budget to grade.

findings: Row 7: the LibreLane flow places the macro-backed design inside the 2x2 core (58.55 %), yet the tracker keeps the row unmet because DR 0005 (SRAM macro) is unratified; the klt P&R leg's first placed measurement (die 161,592 um^2, 8.96 tiles at 41.83 % placed utilization, macro included, no PDN) exceeds the 2x2 budget at that utilization, and the report follows the tracker and does not pick either flow's number as the answer.

Row 4: LibreLane reports 3 of the 6 declared corners as closing with 0 setup/hold violations, and the klt flow now agrees post-route (def mode over the flow-of-record DEF/SPEF: 0 setup and 0 hold violations at the same 3 corners, worst hold +0.103 ns at fast) where its superseded netlist estimate disagreed on hold -- the disagreement was a geometry-stage artifact (no CTS, no routing, no hold repair), not a tool conflict. The residual klt-vs-LibreLane numeric offset (klt uniformly the more optimistic, up to +0.74 ns setup at the slow corner) is the SDC's derates/clock-transition that the klt sta request schema cannot express (2AMLogic/klayout-tools#7025, closed as a duplicate of the open #7014/#7015); both figures stay separately labelled and neither is picked.
